_what: the M13 200M build arm: every data knob equal to ANCHOR's except the dose, the batch, the document policy and the data cut. Validated against the LIVE m10/screen_registry.json by m13src/build_lock.validate before any run; executed by m13src/build13.py.
_authority: m10/M102_LOCK.md (inherited build contract) and research/archive/m10-cleanup-2026-09-10/m10/M102_LOCK.md:73-145 (dose, schedule, optimizer, plateau/kill, the ceiling; its extension cycles are dropped by ruling R13). m13/STAGE1_DESIGN.md §1 is the controller design.
_registry_sha256: RECORDED at validation, not pinned: ruling R9 (strip `pending` from both E arms, re-issue the F verdict) changes the registry sha before the build starts, and a pin here would refuse the very registry the build is supposed to run under. The sha actually validated against goes into results/m13_build_record.json.

documents._why: corpus_loader.arm_doc_count draws ceil(dose x 0.25) UNIQUE documents, i.e. 50,000,000 at 200M against a ~6.15M eligible pool. The archived lock registers 'document epochs ~ 8 over the 6.15M pool' instead: all eligible re-screened documents, repeated, reshuffled per epoch. `n` is a SMOKE-ONLY override and must be null for a registered run.

arm_entry.note: the M13 build arm. Not a screen arm and not a contrast: it is added to an in-memory copy of the screen registry by build13.py and never written into m10/screen_registry.json.

batch_source.rule: rules.E_cost — select bs32 iff E1 (bs32 - bs128) RESOLVES; in every other case bs128
batch_source.refuse: a 'PENDING' batch is refused outside --smoke-steps; both E arms run on the cloud GPU first

data_knobs_equal_to_anchor.head: linear
data_knobs_equal_to_anchor._checked_by: m13src/build_lock.validate against registry `anchor`, `warm_start`, corpus_loader.ARM_SOURCES, nano10.LAYERS and results/m10_screen_verdicts.json:selected

_data_cut: NO cut. The screen's cut applies only to data_cut.applies_to (A2, A3, A4/ANCHOR) and exists so family A's forms contrast is not confounded with volume. The lock's 'query epochs ~ 37 over 4.0M texts' is the FULL A4 (3,486,034 unique texts uncut vs 2,651,572 cut). Ruling R5 confirms this reading.

schedule._implemented_by: m10src/nano10.lr_at (linear peak->final per cycle, last cycle absorbs the remainder), nano10.cycle_ends (boundaries), nano10.warmup_steps_for(batch) (warmup registered in EXAMPLES, rules.E_warmup_parity), wired at m10src/trainer10.py train_arm's `lr = N.lr_at(...)` call.
schedule._no_extension: RULING R13 (Dylan, 2026-09-10): no extension cycles. The build is these three cycles and nothing after them; the lock's permitted extensions are not exercised.

optimizer.name: AdamW
optimizer.precision: bf16 autocast on CUDA, fp32 loss
optimizer._implemented_by: m10src/trainer10.param_groups (decay on dim>1 only), trainer10.train_arm (AdamW betas/eps, clip_grad_norm_ 1.0), trainer10.autocast_for (bf16 on CUDA only), m10src/data10.length_buckets.

_kill_rule: nano10.kill_fires (non-finite, or two consecutive scheduled evaluations more than 0.0056 below the best of their own kind). A kill at any annealed end is a terminal FAILED record with no final checkpoint.
_plateau_rule: nano10.plateau_fires (gain < 0.003 at a cycle end k >= 3), read as a FREEZE: the schedule's last cycle end is its last step, so a plateau there is the ordinary end of the build. Under ruling R13 nothing follows it.
_extensions: NONE (ruling R13, Dylan 2026-09-10). `extension_examples`, `extension_min_gain` and `max_extension_cycles` are gone from this file and build_lock.validate REFUSES a configuration that reintroduces them.

budget._what: a fixed ALLOCATION TABLE, not a cap formula: R13 removed the extension cycles the leftover budget used to buy. build_lock.allocation prices these lines at the measured rate and the billed price and refuses a plan above the ceiling.
budget._reserved_batch_allowance: RULING R10 (Dylan, 2026-09-10, "fine if needed"): 8.0 A100-hours is an ESTIMATE for the conditional reserved batch (~10M stella passage encodes for FEVER and DBpedia-entity plus the two small cqadup components, ~60 GB of vectors within the 500 GB disk); it is re-measured on day one by timing 10,000 passages and the measured figure replaces this one in the allocation table. null REFUSES the allocation outside a smoke rather than quietly pricing it at zero.
budget._note: the rate-derived lines (both cloud E arms, the build itself) are priced from the MEASURED examples/s on day one, not from run_arm.PLAN_RATES, which are projections. `build13.py --plan --rate EX_S --price USD_H` prints the table; a plan above the ceiling is refused.

_torch_compile: registered smoke-only for registered arms unless separately authorized (m10/HEADROOM.md §T, m10/M102_LOCK.md). build13.py refuses --compile outside --smoke-steps.

checkpointing.retained: cycle{k}.pt at every annealed cycle end
checkpointing.loss_history: losses.jsonl beside the checkpoints (trainer10.train_arm(loss_log=...)); the checkpoint keeps only the last 200 losses and the true step count
checkpointing._why_minutes: total_steps // 20 is ~10 GPU-hours of exposure at the build's dose; the cadence is converted to a step interval with the measured rate passed to --rate and recorded.

_lotte_gate: written by stage 3; it may record `skipped`. Its ABSENCE refuses the build (a bs128 selection can still be vetoed in favour of bs32).
